title: Assorted Wall Accessorie Swing Arm Double Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Spanish Gold | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount swing arm double towel rail that keeps towels within reach and folds close to the wall when not in use in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms.

  • Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: crafted for enduring everyday use
  • Concealed screw mounting: clean look with included installation hardware
  • Coordinated design: made to pair with other pieces in the Waverly Place collection

Specifications

  • Category: Assorted Wall Accessories
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Material: Brass
  • Overall dimensions: 12.5 in L x 7 in W x 7.1 in H
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Towel rail and all installation hardware
  • multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
